subject: Studio producer SOW and final PO approval
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sara Mills <sara@studioone.co>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Studio producer SOW and deposit request

Hi team —

We're moving forward with StudioOne for the live regional webinar production on 2026-06-03. Attached is the final SOW from Sara (StudioOne_SOW_RegionalWebinar_2026-06-03.pdf). Total not-to-exceed is $12,500 (line items: producer $6,000; tech crew $4,000; equipment + prep $2,500).

StudioOne requires a 50% deposit to lock the studio and producer dates (they've held the dates tentatively). We need a PO or an approved spend method by end of week to avoid losing the slot.

Ask: Could finance/procurement confirm whether we should issue a PO or use the team P-Card for this? If PO, please confirm cost center / GL mapping and whether a PO number can be issued before EOD Friday (2026-05-14).

Attachments: StudioOne_SOW_RegionalWebinar_2026-06-03.pdf

Quick context: This is part of the Q3 product webinar series (marketing-owned). We've budgeted for it, but it sits near the spend cap for the quarter so I'm flagging for explicit approval.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Studio producer SOW and deposit request

Thanks, Avery.

High-level: finance can approve a PO for this amount, but we need the following before issuing:
- Vendor W9 and bank details (for ACH) — required for vendor onboarding.
- Final line-item invoice or pro-forma showing the deposit amount and balance schedule.
- Confirmation of GL / cost center to charge (please confirm the marketing cost center).

Suggested / provisional mapping: 4302-Marketing Events (please confirm with budget owner). If that code is confirmed, I'll provisionally approve the PO issuance to avoid delay; final PO will reference the confirmed cost center.

P-Card option: Given the vendor amount, P-Card is not preferred (limits and accounting reconciliation). PO is the cleaner path.

If procurement (Logan) can create a PO number once we have the W9 and invoice, we can instruct StudioOne to invoice against PO and accept the 50% deposit.

Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue & Ops
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sara Mills <sara@studioone.co>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: StudioOne Contracts <contracts@studioone.co>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Studio producer SOW and deposit request

Thanks, Avery & team. Attached: StudioOne_invoice_12345.pdf and W9_StudioOne.pdf. Per our terms the deposit is 50% ($6,250) due to secure the studio and hold producer. Remaining balance invoiced after the event.

Pay via ACH to the account on the W9; net 30 on final balance. If you prefer a PO, include PO number on the invoice and we will apply the deposit against that PO. If you need a shorter payment window for the deposit (same-day ACH), let us know and we can accept a payment confirmation email with remittance.

Our contact for contracts is contracts@studioone.co — they're on copy.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sara Mills
Head of Production, StudioOne Productions
sara@studioone.co

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Studio producer SOW and deposit request

Avery / Marissa —

I've set up the PO and assigned PO number PO-2026-0789. Cost center confirmed as 4302-Marketing Events per Marissa's provisional mapping. Procurement will issue the PO and send the official PO and remittance instructions to StudioOne Contracts (contracts@studioone.co) this afternoon.

Next steps (procurement):
- Attach vendor W9 and invoice to the PO (attached here for records).
- Issue PO-2026-0789 to contracts@studioone.co and confirm deposit routing (50% = $6,250).
- Update PR-4521 in the procurement tracker (link: https://app.redwood.com/procurement/requests/PR-4521).

Avery — once PO is out, please confirm with StudioOne that they will accept invoice against PO and request deposit remittance window. If you want me to coordinate payment approval, I can kick that off with treasury.

Attachments: StudioOne_SOW_RegionalWebinar_2026-06-03.pdf; StudioOne_invoice_12345.pdf; W9_StudioOne.pdf

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Procurement Operations Lead
logan_wright@redwood.com
